title: ever NOVA|Sweetheart Draped Back Maxi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant and chic bridesmaid dress is extremely flattering for any body type. It is crafted with flowy chiffon fabric that moves with you. It consists of a sweetheart neckline, a pleated bodice, a draped low back, and ends with a floor-length skirt suitable for dancing the night away!

Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Maxi.

Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.

Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
